analysis.reasonEn: Following 3 consecutive bullish days and RSI entering overbought territory, RSI has consolidated in the neutral zone and MACD improvement has slowed since 5 days ago. The current price of $64.06 is 2.3% below the 52-week high of $65.52 and approaching the swing resistance of $64.70. Weekly ADX remains strong at 31.3, indicating a clear trend, but daily upward momentum has weakened. The 4-hour RSI at 60.1 has declined, weakening multi-timeframe alignment. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted to confirm further upside potential.
